source: ADEK AI Literacy Curriculum — Scope & Sequence, KG to Grade 12, Term 1

strandRows.row: Knowing how intelligent systems learn and operate
Working with data, and designing solutions
Exercising judgement in the use of AI systems
Assessing AI systems for ethical use

CU.label: AI Conceptual Understanding
CU.frameworkRow: Knowing how intelligent systems learn and operate

emerging.descriptor: Notices that machines or objects respond to human actions through unplugged observation.

proficient.descriptor: Identifies simple sensors (e.g., cameras, microphones) and distinguishes them from human senses.

advanced.descriptor: Describes simple cause-and-effect relationships independently during physical play.

DA.label: Data Awareness
DA.frameworkRow: Working with data, and designing solutions

emerging.descriptor: Recognises that information is needed to complete a task in guided physical examples.

proficient.descriptor: Sorts physical objects and explains grouping by one attribute (e.g., colour, shape, size).

advanced.descriptor: Sorts using multiple attributes and explains how grouping supports decision-making.

CE.label: Critical Evaluation & Informed Interaction
CE.frameworkRow: Exercising judgement in the use of AI systems

emerging.descriptor: Follows one-step instructions from a peer or teacher during role-play.

proficient.descriptor: Follows and gives simple 1–2 step instructions clearly.

advanced.descriptor: Identifies unclear instructions and suggests simple improvements independently.

GE.label: Ethics & Privacy
GE.frameworkRow: Assessing AI systems for ethical use

emerging.descriptor: Recognises personal information (e.g., name, age) when prompted.

proficient.descriptor: Explains that some information is private and seeks adult help when unsure.

advanced.descriptor: Demonstrates safe behaviour in social play and explains why it is important.

CU.label: AI Conceptual Understanding
CU.frameworkRow: Knowing how intelligent systems learn and operate

emerging.descriptor: Recognises that some digital tools respond to inputs (e.g., voice, touch).

proficient.descriptor: Explains simple differences between human decisions and machine responses.

advanced.descriptor: Explores how sensors and patterns influence responses through structured play.

DA.label: Data Awareness
DA.frameworkRow: Working with data, and designing solutions

emerging.descriptor: Understands that machines use information to respond.

proficient.descriptor: Sorts and groups objects using more than one attribute and explains reasoning.

advanced.descriptor: Demonstrates that incomplete or incorrect information leads to incorrect outcomes.

CE.label: Critical Evaluation & Informed Interaction
CE.frameworkRow: Exercising judgement in the use of AI systems

emerging.descriptor: Recognises that clearer instructions lead to better responses.

proficient.descriptor: Gives clear 2–3 step instructions and adjusts wording when needed.

advanced.descriptor: Demonstrates persistence in refining instructions through iterative play.

GE.label: Ethics & Privacy
GE.frameworkRow: Assessing AI systems for ethical use

emerging.descriptor: Understands basic ideas of privacy and fairness in simple contexts.

proficient.descriptor: Identifies personal information and explains why it should be kept private.

advanced.descriptor: Consistently demonstrates safe, fair, and respectful behaviour in interactions.

CU.label: AI Conceptual Understanding
CU.frameworkRow: Knowing how intelligent systems learn and operate

emerging.descriptor: Recognises that machines follow simple rules to respond.

proficient.descriptor: Describes inputs and outputs using everyday examples.

advanced.descriptor: Explains how changing an input changes the output.

DA.label: Data Awareness
DA.frameworkRow: Working with data, and designing solutions

emerging.descriptor: Sorts information into simple groups with guidance.

proficient.descriptor: Sorts information independently using one attribute.

advanced.descriptor: Explains how different information leads to different results.

CE.label: Critical Evaluation & Informed Interaction
CE.frameworkRow: Exercising judgement in the use of AI systems

emerging.descriptor: Follows simple step-by-step instructions with support.

proficient.descriptor: Creates simple step sequences to complete a task.

advanced.descriptor: Adjusts steps when outcomes are not correct.

GE.label: Responsible AI Use
GE.frameworkRow: Assessing AI systems for ethical use

emerging.descriptor: Identifies personal information and safe sharing.

proficient.descriptor: Follows rules for safe and respectful use.

advanced.descriptor: Explains fairness in simple situations.

CU.label: AI Conceptual Understanding
CU.frameworkRow: Knowing how intelligent systems learn and operate

emerging.descriptor: Recognises that systems follow rules and make simple choices.

proficient.descriptor: Explains simple decision logic (if/then).

advanced.descriptor: Explains how rules affect outcomes in different situations.

DA.label: Data Awareness
DA.frameworkRow: Working with data, and designing solutions

emerging.descriptor: Sorts information using one attribute.

proficient.descriptor: Sorts using more than one attribute.

advanced.descriptor: Explains how incorrect or missing information affects outcomes.

CE.label: Critical Evaluation & Informed Interaction
CE.frameworkRow: Exercising judgement in the use of AI systems

emerging.descriptor: Uses simple step-by-step instructions.

proficient.descriptor: Creates multi-step instructions to solve a task.

advanced.descriptor: Improves instructions to make outcomes more accurate.

GE.label: Responsible AI Use
GE.frameworkRow: Assessing AI systems for ethical use

emerging.descriptor: Identifies safe vs unsafe sharing.

proficient.descriptor: Explains fairness in simple examples.

advanced.descriptor: Recognises when outcomes may be unfair.

CU.label: AI Conceptual Understanding
CU.frameworkRow: Knowing how intelligent systems learn and operate

emerging.descriptor: Recognises that multiple rules can be combined.

proficient.descriptor: Explains how combining rules affects outcomes.

advanced.descriptor: Predicts outcomes when rules are changed.

DA.label: Data Awareness
DA.frameworkRow: Working with data, and designing solutions

emerging.descriptor: Recognises that different information affects decisions.

proficient.descriptor: Explains how missing or incorrect information changes outcomes.

advanced.descriptor: Identifies simple errors in information and suggests improvements.

CE.label: Critical Evaluation & Informed Interaction
CE.frameworkRow: Exercising judgement in the use of AI systems

emerging.descriptor: Creates multi-step instructions with support.

proficient.descriptor: Creates structured instructions combining steps and conditions.

proficient.descriptor: Explains how rules can create unfair outcomes.

CU.label: AI Conceptual Understanding
CU.frameworkRow: Knowing how intelligent systems learn and operate

CE.label: Critical Evaluation & Informed Interaction

GE.label: Responsible AI Use

CU.label: AI Conceptual Understanding
CU.frameworkRow: Knowing how intelligent systems learn and operate

DA.label: Data Literacy
